text:
alexa: Heads-up — saw a customer report where a streamed response that got truncated + client retry caused a duplicate tool call charge in the ledger. Anyone else seen this?
jamal: ugh. repro steps?
alexa: quick gist: client opened stream, got a `FIN` chunk at token ~1200 (truncated), client reconnected -> server re-routed request to fallback model variant -> toolcall executed again. Billing shows both provisional and final credits counted.
kevin: can you paste the session headers? suspect session id changed on reconnect so dedupe missed.
alexa: header was `X-Session: reed-7b-973` on original, on reconnect client used `X-Session: reed-7b-973` (same) but we changed route to a different shard, so dedupe cache not shared.
rachel: so dedupe is per-shard in routing layer currently, right? that explains it.
jamal: yes. routing affinity keyed to shard + session id. if we fallback/regional-reroute we lose cross-shard dedupe.
billing-bot: INFO billing: provisional_charge(session=reed-7b-973, tokens=1200)
billing-bot: INFO billing: confirmed_charge(session=reed-7b-973, tokens=1189)
alexa: logged console snapshots: provisional remained visible as refunded=false, so UI showed double charge.
kevin: short-term: mark provisional as transient in UI (gray) and add a note about fallbacks until ledger reconciliation completes. long-term: need a cross-shard provisional id or global dedupe table.
rachel: cross-shard table is hairy (consistency/cost). alternative: route reconnects to original shard for a grace window.
jamal: proposal: for reconnectes within 30s, prefer original route if capacity permits. add route header `X-Prev-Shard: <id>` so shard can query local cache -> fallback to global only if miss.
alexa: that seems workable. We should also add a console flag: show provisional vs final and an ops link to refund quickly.
devex: UI mock: add a small badge "provisional" + hover text "may be deduped on ledger reconciliation" and a link "Request refund" that creates a ticket.
eke: (typo)
kevin: steps: 1) implement `X-Prev-Shard` passthrough in router (short PR) 2) shard checks local dedupe cache on reconnect 3) if miss, consult a lightweight global index (async) 4) console: provisional badge + ops action.
jamal: will open infra ticket and tag billing and routing teams.
alexa: created ticket INC-7421 with repro trace + logs. cc @kevin @rachel. can we prioritize P2? customer impacted but workaround exists.
rachel: P2 ok. I'll add a short runbook for support: how to spot double provisional in console and escalate for refund.
alexa: thanks. one more note: we should also instrument metrics for "provisional_count -> confirmed_count" delta by route to monitor improvements. :eyes:
